title: Desk Tool Card — Restating the Performance Baseline of an Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscription
content:
# Restating the Performance Baseline

Desk tool card for the restatement of the performance baseline a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions measures against.

## When the baseline is restated

When a replacement or retrofit project at the building closes and the tier resets its baseline on retrofit, the performance baseline the subscription measures against is restated, because measuring new equipment against the use of the old plant would credit the company with savings it did not manage. Once restated, every later comparison of the building's use is made against the new figure and the owner sees it on the account.

The reset baseline is fixed only once the metered points the subscription covers match the points the site meters.

## The tool

`reset_performance_baseline_0e66b991` is an agent-side tool: the client services agent unlocks it and calls it, replacing the baseline standing on the subscription with the annual electricity figure entered. The change is stamped on the subscription as a baseline reset dated the day it is made.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `subscription_id` | the reference number of the energy monitoring subscription whose baseline is being restated, read from the subscription lookup for this building owner | Id |
| `baseline_kwh` | the baseline annual electricity use to stand on the subscription, expressed exactly as the record holds it | integer, kilowatt hours per year; never blank and never carrying a decimal part |

## Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text naming the subscription and the baseline annual electricity use in kilowatt hours now standing on it. Any sentence of that shape means the baseline on the account has been replaced. No other return is defined.
